# Nonconforming LD/residual geometry experiments

These 462 MP4/MKV pairs are profile counterexamples,not LD-MPS codec acceptance.
See `docs/LD_MPS_PROFILE.md`. Ordinary MP4 controls and six48-frame scalar-core
controls remain positive tests. Native export/reader factories must refuse the
residual combinations before PCM. Standalone numerical tools retain their
50,466,816-value signal/ICC and8190-spectrum/234-extra-short checks.

Generate explicitly with `python3 scripts/generate_aac_eld_residual64_geometries_fixtures.py`.
The five2/3/4-core geometries,24/32/48kHz residual rates,seven parameter grids
and six modes are synthetic mathematical test inputs. They do not establish
ordinary MPEG Surround/HQ residual integration or profile conformance.
All media/parameters are authored locally;no private source data. Own generation
and ordinary tests use no FFmpeg,network or external process.
